description: This file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface in the Orleans.Hosting namespace, allowing configuration of services, options, and logging for silo instances.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring ISiloBuilder instances.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Adds services to the container, allowing multiple calls to be additive.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures options of type TOptions using a provided action.

methods.name: Configure (overload with IConfiguration)
methods.description: Binds a configuration instance to options of type TOptions.

methods.name: ConfigureLogging
methods.description: Adds a delegate for configuring logging, supporting multiple calls.
